svg.title: 20. Neck turn stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Keep your shoulders facing forwards. Turn your head slowly to look over one shoulder. Stop before you feel pain or strain.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.cuh.nhs.uk/patient-information/stretches-back-pain-management-programme/
